raw_posts.name: Dograh
raw_posts.description: Closed voice platforms make you rent your own agents. Dograh is completely open source- nothing is gated. Visual flow builder, add your model key across 30+ integrations or use local models, telephony, human transfer, and advanced QA & monitoring - all free to self-host in one command. Also connect your claude code with MCP to build voice agents for a use case or call recordings.

raw_posts.name: Grok Bot
raw_posts.tagline: AI teammates that you can give real work to
raw_posts.description: Introducing Grok Bot: AI teammates you can give real work to. Bots sign into your tools, use them like you do, and come back with finished work. Message them like a teammate. They keep context, multitask, and learn your working style on their own cloud computer. Ask Bots to run outbound overnight, code expenses from Gmail, schedule a recruiting onsite, rebalance paid ads, or ship a bug pack. They only come back when something needs your approval.

raw_posts.name: Lettertrace
raw_posts.tagline: Track your AI visibility for free (using your own API keys!)
raw_posts.description: Lettertrace measures how often Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini mention your company. But there's a catch: it's free, developer-first, bring-your-own-key, and open source.

raw_posts.name: Assembly Studio
raw_posts.tagline: AI app builder that grows your revenue
raw_posts.description: Assembly Studio is the AI app builder made for professional service firms. Describe what you want: onboarding agents, analytics dashboards, community hubs, and get production-grade apps in minutes. 20+ templates to remix. Connects to any 3rd-party tool. Clone any overpriced app charging you per seat. Free forever plan. Stop paying for someone else's software. Build the firm only you can build.

raw_posts.name: Unsloth Desktop
raw_posts.tagline: Run and train AI models locally on your desktop
raw_posts.description: Unsloth Desktop is an open-source app to run and train AI models locally. Run LLMs, image/video diffusion, and audio. Connect agents like Claude Code or Codex to your local GPU with one command, and fine-tune models with no-code workflows.

raw_posts.name: BearDrive
raw_posts.tagline: The open-source shared folder for your team's AI agents
raw_posts.description: Your AI agents create real files locally: reports, decks, CSVs, research. BearDrive syncs the folder they already work in, so every file is born shared: versioned, attributed down to the agent session, with links only your team can open. Unlike Notion or Drive, nobody moves anything; a teammate's agent reads your agent's work at a real local path seconds later. Works with Claude Code, Cowork, Codex, Gemini CLI, any local tool. Open source and self-hostable. Managed service free during beta.

raw_posts.name: LaraCopilot
raw_posts.tagline: Agentic AI Engineer that builds real apps
raw_posts.description: LaraCopilot is an agentic AI engineer that builds real, production-ready apps. Describe your idea in your own language and it builds the whole thing: UI, backend, database, auth, and APIs, wired together and ready to deploy. One-click deploy to the cloud or your own server, GitHub export, instant rollback. No lock-in. The code is yours.

raw_posts.name: Swipe
raw_posts.tagline: Swipe right on your next customer
raw_posts.description: Type who you sell to. Swipe deals a ranked deck of real companies. Keep the ones worth an email, skip the rest, export to CSV. No signup, no credits, no scraped inboxes.

raw_posts.name: Click
raw_posts.tagline: Live research context for ChatGPT and Claude
raw_posts.description: Click is an MCP that provides extensive research connectors to give external context that the built-in web search misses. It provides live context from professional & social platforms, marketplaces, financials, and more. A simple 1-min installation of the MCP in ChatGPT or Claude enables you to do more inside chat.

raw_posts.name: RightCard
raw_posts.tagline: The honest credit card picker — no bank login
raw_posts.description: RightCard tells you which of your cards to use at any store and auto-adds the bank offers you'd forget to activate (Amex, Chase, Citi, Wells Fargo). It keeps rotating 5% categories straight so you don't have to remember them, and warns you before card credits and annual fees renew. No bank login, no account, no tracking — the Safari extension reads the offers page you're already signed into, and recommendations are computed on your phone, even offline. Honest numbers only. Free, no ads.
